**In one line**: Alabama has reportedly issued a subpoena to OpenAI over a reported incident tied to Hugging Face.

### Key points
- State authorities in Alabama have reportedly issued a **subpoena** to OpenAI.
- The action is said to stem from an incident connected to the AI model-sharing platform **Hugging Face**.
- A subpoena is an early investigative step demanding records or documents, and does not by itself indicate any wrongdoing.
- Details of the incident and OpenAI's official response remain unconfirmed at this stage.

### Why it matters
A state-level enforcement body pressing directly on a major AI company shows that AI oversight is emerging not only at the federal level but across individual states. Whether similar moves spread to other states is worth watching.
